column1: # comment: "Direction: subject (Senologie) <predicate> object (ECCDM hub). Terminology deferred (subject_terminology blank/—). v0.2.0 covers all 11 hub models: CancerPatient and ActiveSurveillance are full GAPs (no patient-demographic or surveillance elements in clinical LM); Tumorkonferenz (17 elements) is an inverse-gap (rich MDO concept, no ECCDM hub counterpart)."

column13: comment

ICD-O-3 morphology (incl. /Behaviour suffix). Pathologie is 0..*, so the same element covers both biopsy and resection specimen instances; Praeparat.Art (Biopsie/Resektat) disambiguates at instance level. No explicit pre-operative/post-operative split at element level (unlike NABON). Hub field 0..1 -> selection of the primary Pathologie instance required when multiple instances exist.

Laterality component (Left/Right/Bilateral); Hub bodySite = 1 CodeableConcept -> Quadrant (senol:.Quadrant) and clock position must be merged. Collision with the Quadrant row resolved via source_context.

Quadrant localisation (OA/OI/UA/UI etc.); Hub bodySite = 1 CodeableConcept -> laterality (senol:.Seite) and optional clock position required. Richer than oBDS (oBDS = ICD-O-3 topography; Senologie = quadrant + clock position explicit).

Nottingham/BRE grade G1-G4 for invasive breast carcinoma. tumourGradeSystem has NO Senologie field -> system is implicit (Nottingham convention for invasive breast). Collision with BefundDCIS.Grading resolved via source_context.

DCIS-specific grading G1-G3 (Van Nuys/nuclear grading). Separate field compared to invasive grading (Senologie advantage vs. oBDS unified field). Hub collapses invasive + DCIS into one tumourGradeValue field -> information loss (hub limitation). tumourGradeSystem GAP unchanged.

assertedDate of diagnosis; semantically close to Hub visitDate (date of diagnostic visit). Hub separates visit/biopsy/imaging/lab; Senologie provides BildgebungMamma.Datum, Pathologie.DatumEntnahme, Pathologie.Datum as separate fields (advantage). Collision with Vorstellung.Erstvorstellung resolved via source_context.

Date of first clinical presentation; may precede the diagnosis date by days/weeks. Hub visitDate is semantically closer to the first diagnosis date; nonetheless the most relevant alternative source for visit date in the Senologie chain.

Date of specimen collection (biopsy or resection specimen); Hub biopsyDate implies biopsy in the narrow sense. Praeparat.Art (Biopsie vs. Resektat) required to filter for biopsy-specific instances. Pathologie.DatumProbeneingang (laboratory receipt date) as alternative if collection date is absent.

Direct equivalent: date of breast imaging (mammography/ultrasound/MRI/tomosynthesis). BildgebungMamma is 0..* -> selection of the diagnostically relevant instance required when multiple imaging instances exist.

Date the pathology report was issued = laboratory/pathology report date. Hub labReportDate = date of laboratory report (Pathologie). Senologie additionally distinguishes specimen receipt (DatumProbeneingang) and report notification (DatumMitteilungPatient) -> finer-grained than ECCDM.

Breast-cancer-specific clinical T-category (x/0/is/1a/b/c/2/3/4a-d); narrowMatch due to breast sub-categorisation. CancerStage.type=klinisch implied; stage.code (T-category label) has no Senologie counterpart (structural). Collision with patho_invasiv_pT resolved via source_context.
Breast-cancer-specific clinical N-category (x/0/1/2a/b/3a/b/c); narrowMatch. Collision with patho_invasiv_pN resolved via source_context.
Clinical M-category (0/1); Senologie separates cM (KlinischeUntersuchung) and pM (Pathologie.M). Collision with patho_M resolved via source_context.
Clinical overall UICC stage (I/II/III/IV); closeMatch. Collision with patho_UICC resolved via source_context. Hub classificationType (TNM version) has no Senologie counterpart (GAP).

Pathological T-category for invasive breast carcinoma; narrowMatch (BC sub-categories). CancerStage.type=pathologisch; y-prefix (BefundInvasiv.y) for post-neoadjuvant findings has no direct Hub field. Collision with patho_dcis_pT via source_context.

Pathological N-category for invasive carcinoma. Senologie advantage: LymphknotenUntersucht/LymphknotenBefallen, SentinelUntersucht/SentinelBefallen have no ECCDM counterpart. Collision with klinisch_cN via source_context.

T-category for DCIS (typically pTis); DCIS-specific. Hub collapses invasive and DCIS into the same CancerStage type -> source_context disambiguates. Collision with patho_invasiv_pT via source_context.
Pathological N-category for DCIS; rarely positive. Disambiguation of DCIS vs. invasive via source_context required.
Pathological M-classification applies to both invasive and DCIS; closeMatch. Collision with klinisch_cM via source_context.
Pathological overall UICC stage; closeMatch. Collision with klinisch_UICC via source_context.

Direct equivalent: date of surgery. Operation is 0..* (multiple surgeries possible). GAP: Operation.Art (Mastektomie/BET/SNB/Rekonstruktion) has no Surgery hub counterpart; R-status only in the Pathologie model, not in ECCDM Surgery.

Laterality of the surgery (Left/Right); Hub bodySite = body site as CodeableConcept. Senologie provides only laterality; breast body site is implicit (model context). For a complete bodySite, Seite + implicit breast localisation must be combined.

Diagnostic/therapeutic vs. Hub curative/palliative/diagnostic; vocabulary offset. Therapeutic ~ curative for breast carcinoma. Operative complications (Clavien-Dindo) and implant details in Senologie have no ECCDM counterpart.

Neoadjuvant/adjuvant/palliative = direct counterpart to Hub Intent. GAP: therapy line (1st/2nd/3rd) and FirstLineMetastasiert have no Hub equivalent; SystemicTreatment.setting has no direct Senologie counterpart (Intention overlapping but not identical).
Direct equivalent: start date of systemic therapy.
Direct equivalent: end date. Hub SystemicTreatment.ongoing has no direct Senologie field (GAP: must be derived from an absent end date).

Protocol name (AC-T/FEC-D etc.) is finer than hub type (Chemotherapy/Immunotherapy/Targeted/Endocrine); narrowMatch. Medikation.Substanz is even finer (single-substance level) with no Hub counterpart. Senologie advantage: substance-level dose/cycle data have no ECCDM equivalent.

Adjuvant/neoadjuvant/palliative = direct counterpart to Radiotherapy.intent. Senologie advantage: Gesamtdosis, Einzeldosis, AnzahlFraktionen, SimultaneRadiochemotherapie have no ECCDM equivalent. Radiotherapy.setting has no Senologie counterpart (GAP).
Direct equivalent: start of radiotherapy.
Direct equivalent: end of radiotherapy.
Breast-cancer-specific irradiation region (Brust/Thoraxwand/Lymphabflussgebiet/Boost) finer than generic Hub bodySite CodeableConcept; narrowMatch.

Follow-up report date (oBDS M01) closeMatch to Hub assertedDate. Hub expects the date of a defined progression event; Senologie Verlauf is a periodic follow-up report. GAP: tumourGradeSystem/Value in ClinicalCancerProgression has no Verlauf counterpart (grading only in Pathologie).
CR/PR/SD/PD (oBDS) closeMatch to Hub diseaseStatus. extentType (locoregional vs. distant metastases) has no direct Senologie Verlauf field; Diagnose.Falltyp provides rough orientation (GAP).
Local tumour status (oBDS M05); narrowMatch due to BC-specific status coding. Collision with TumorstatusLK (also locoRegionalSites) resolved via source_context lokal/lymphknoten.

Lymph node tumour status (oBDS M06) as locoregional status; narrowMatch. Senologie explicitly distinguishes Lokal/LK/FM (three fields); Hub combines Lokal+LK in locoRegionalSites (lower granularity). Collision with TumorstatusLokal via source_context.
Distant metastasis tumour status (oBDS M07); closeMatch. Senologie encodes presence/absence without a specific location code; Hub expects a location CodeableConcept (potential information loss).

CR/PR/SD/PD closeMatch to treatmentResponseType. closeMatch rather than exactMatch: Verlauf.Gesamtbeurteilung is a cumulative status assessment, not a therapy-episode-bound response. ECCDM OACR links to clinicalCancerProgressionReference; Senologie has no dedicated response entity (structural GAP).

Follow-up report date as proxy for response assessment date. Same source field as ClinicalCancerProgression.assertedDate and LastFollowUp.date (different Hub context; no collision issue as object_ids differ).

Alive/deceased/unknown (oBDS M04) nearly a direct equivalent to Hub vitalStatus. closeMatch due to possible vocabulary divergence. GAP: causeOfDeath and deathDate have no Senologie Verlauf counterpart (year of death/cause of death not documented in the LM).

Most recent Verlauf.Meldedatum approximates LastFollowUp.date. Verlauf is 0..* -> selection of the most recent instance required. Multi-mapping of the same source field to OACR.date and ClinicalCancerProgression.assertedDate (different Hub models; no collision issue).

CR/PR/SD/PD finer than Hub boolean evidenceOfDisease (yes/no disease evidence); narrowMatch. Derivable from Gesamtbeurteilung: PD/SD -> true, CR -> false, PR context-dependent. Confidence 0.60 due to semantic drift (categorical vs. boolean type).

Modality Mammografie/Sonografie/MRT/Tomosynthese directly equivalent to Hub Imaging.type. GAP: no explicit bodySite field in BildgebungMamma (breast implied by model name). Senologie advantage: BIRADS, ACRDichte, Herdbefund, Mikrokalk have no ECCDM counterpart. Collision with BildgebungSonstige.Art resolved via source_context mamma/sonstige.
CT/PET-CT/Szintigrafie for staging imaging outside breast primary diagnostics; closeMatch. Vocabulary is broader and staging-oriented. Collision with BildgebungMamma.Art via source_context.
